title: GrowWithHR Gratuity Wave 5D Governed Source-Readiness Catalogue

sourcePack.name: GrowWithHR Gratuity Chapter V controlled source snapshot
sourcePack.notes: All four records are existing controlled full files with registered SHA-256 fingerprints. Wave 5D adds no new source-file acquisition and makes no customer coverage or individual entitlement determination.

limitations: The Wave 5D catalogue remains needs-legal-review and is not a Gratuity coverage, eligibility, amount, claim, appeal, recovery or remedy determination.
Only organisation-level source-readiness, schedule, transition, classification-control, authority-process and escalation statuses plus controlled references are eligible for retrieval context.
Retrieval cannot infer establishment classification, employee counts, fixed-term status, service, wages, nominee or heir facts, calculate gratuity or change the deterministic decision.

chunks.title: Gratuity Chapter V source boundary
chunks.text: The controlled Code source identifies Chapter V, sections 53 to 58, as the gratuity framework. Wave 5D uses those provisions only for source-readiness and organisational-control review and does not decide whether a customer or individual is covered.

chunks.title: First Schedule Gratuity applicability source
chunks.sectionReference: First Schedule — Chapter V Gratuity applicability entry
chunks.text: The First Schedule contains the Chapter V gratuity applicability entry. Wave 5D records whether that source is controlled but does not classify an establishment, count employees or determine customer coverage.

chunks.title: Current Central Gratuity Rules source
chunks.text: The controlled Social Security Central Rules contain the Gratuity chapter at Rules 31 to 34. These rules are used only for source-readiness, nomination/process and authority-routing context; no individual claim, amount or entitlement is decided.

chunks.title: Legacy Gratuity Rules transition source
chunks.text: The Central Rules supersede the Payment of Gratuity (Central) Rules, 1972 subject to savings for things already done or omitted. Wave 5D records that transition control only and does not resolve State rules, saved rights, pending proceedings or customer-specific transition questions.

chunks.title: Gratuity commencement context
chunks.text: The controlled S.O. 5319(E) commencement notification is retained as Chapter V implementation and effective-date context. Retrieval cannot turn commencement context into a customer coverage or individual entitlement conclusion.

chunks.title: Commencement corrigendum context
chunks.text: The controlled S.O. 5936(E) corrigendum remains a companion commencement source. It must be evaluated together with the principal notification and cannot independently create or change Gratuity applicability.

chunks.title: Classification controls remain organisational only
chunks.sectionReference: First Schedule and Chapter V source-control boundary
chunks.text: Establishment classification and workforce-category source controls are organisation-level statuses only. The product cannot infer a factory, mine, oilfield, plantation, port, railway-company, shop or establishment classification, employee count, fixed-term status, service period or wage facts.

chunks.title: Authority and process boundary
chunks.text: Authority and process sources may explain the existence of nomination, competent-authority, appeal or recovery pathways, but Wave 5D cannot accept claim bodies, notices, orders, identities, nominee or heir data or decide any disputed entitlement, amount, appeal, recovery or remedy.
